text_block_list.text:
Hah... Whether I like it or not, I know it's
my pride
to blame.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I thought I had gotten stronger, but in
truth... I'm
still weak.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I need to come to grips with the fact.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
There's no one more foolish than an
arrogant
person who doesn't know their
own weakness.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: It was still a great race, Brian.

text_block_list.text: Cut it out. I get it already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The other racers at the Kikuka Sho
today were
just stronger than me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
But, I'm not just going to let that slide
forever.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is over, and I
let the title
of the strongest racer slip
away...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Help me take out every speck
of
weakness we found today.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Rip those weaknesses out and use them
as fuel to
shape me into a runner
capable of the victory I've
been
dreaming of.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Right now, the others are all getting
stronger...
No doubt Amazon is too!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.text:
I know I can get stronger if you'll stick
with me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And so, Нарита Брайан's Classic Triple
Crown tour
comes to an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the Arima Kinen at the
end of the
year, where Хиши Амадзон
and the senior racers
await!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
